info.title: KAIRO API
info.description: Languages, sandboxed executions, normalized diagnostics and Saarthi, the AI assistant.

get.description: API status plus what the runner reports (cached for a few seconds).

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description:
Languages this deployment supports, with their toolchains and limits.

`available` tells the editor which ones can run right now: a language whose
sandbox image is not installed on the runner is listed but not offered.
Profiles that are not languages of their own (the notebook runner) are not
listed; they can still be run by id.

schema.title: Response List Languages Api V1 Languages Get

post.description: Queue a compile-and-run of the given source. Returns immediately.
Queue a compile-and-run and stream its snapshots until it finishes (one request, no WebSocket).

200.description: One ExecutionOut per line, ending with the terminal one.

post.description: Explain a diagnostic of a finished run, grounded in that run's evidence.
Propose the smallest patch for a diagnostic. The student must approve it.
Decide from a real run of the patched code whether a fix worked.
Answer a question about programming, the editor's code or a run.
Answer a question, streaming the text while the model writes it (one JSON object per line).

200.description: start, then delta events with the text as it is written, then done (or error).

post.description: Suggest what comes next at the cursor (the editor shows it as ghost text; Tab accepts).

executionId.title: Executionid

source.title: Source
source.description: The editor's code when there is no run to ground the answer in.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: The run's sealed evidence from its final snapshot; lets any server instance answer about a run it did not execute. The server checks the seal.

diagnosticId.title: Diagnosticid
diagnosticId.description: With executionId: the diagnostic the question is about.

reason.description: Why Saarthi is unavailable, in plain words.

completion.description: Text to insert at the cursor; empty when the model has nothing useful.

stdin.title: Stdin

diagnosticIds.title: Diagnosticids

evidence.title: Evidence

fixId.title: Fixid

baseSourceHash.title: Basesourcehash

targetCodes.title: Targetcodes
targetCodes.description: Diagnostic codes the fix is meant to remove.

fixToken.description: The sealed proposal; send it back to /verify.

status.title: Status

available.title: Available
available.description: Whether the sandbox runner has this language's toolchain image installed. null when the runner cannot be reached right now.

label.title: Label
label.description: Shown in the run pipeline, e.g. "Compile" or "Syntax check".

argv.title: Argv

startLine.title: Startline
startLine.description: First replaced line (1-based, in the original source).

replacement.title: Replacement
replacement.description: The new lines; empty deletes the range.

RawOutputReference.title: RawOutputReference

version.description: Exact version read from the sandbox image; null if unknown.

executionId.title: Executionid
